svg.title: Two evidence streams for the alfalfa root-zone microbiome
svg.desc: A stylized alfalfa plant and salinity gradient introduce two complementary reanalyses. Report 1 shows the actual nine-sample genus and normalized functional ordinations for CK, LS and MS. Report 2 shows the actual CK-1 and MS-1 read-fate and published-versus-reconstructed taxonomic comparison figures. Findings are descriptive within the limits of replication and database coverage.
svg.text: Published profiles reveal community patterns; deposited reads test taxonomic reproducibility.
CK, LS and MS · three sequenced samples per treatment

svg.text: Community structure: R² = 0.775 · alpha diversity overlaps
Raw functional PCoA1 tracks pathway total (r = −0.9988).
CK-3 differs in composition; measured soil values remain CK-like.
Genomic potential is not activity · nitrogen Figure 7 lacks a full identifier crosswalk
SRA → QC → host depletion → Kraken2 / Bracken

ns0:text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #62727d

ns0:g.ns0:text: exact-name matching is not a synonym or TaxID crosswalk.

svg.text: Both runs validated; exact-label disagreement does not establish taxon absence.
Ecological patterns and reconstruction choices both matter. Replication, reference coverage and incomplete annotations limit interpretation.
